messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete for inference-service:v7.3 -> canary. Heartbeat probes and prefills enabled for all regions. dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/rollouts/3412349999
tara: noted. starting post-deploy healthwatch (region: us-east-2) 60 synthetic heartbeats across 12 hosts.
neil: first batch (60): 5 soft failures (timeouts 504) clustered at 12:40 window, p95 jumped from 120ms->420ms. collecting logs.
ops-bot: Infra alert: increased TCP retransmits observed on host-use2-03 and host-use2-09 between 12:39-12:41. Ticket INF-5342 created.
tara: snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-06-11T12:40:12Z heartbeat-synth id=hb-77 host=use2-09 status=504 upstream=timeout latency=420ms
```
neil: app logs show request queued due to slow kv warmup on that host; not OOM. kernel shows high retransmit count.
harry: suggestion: 1) pause final 100% ramp for 20m, 2) mark use2-03 & use2-09 for draining, 3) reduce heartbeat fanout from 12 -> 4 for canary to avoid warmup stampede, 4) re-run 200 quick-heartbeats. If >1% errors persist or p95 > 350ms, pin us-east-2 traffic to v7-stable variant.
tara: +1. scaling down fanout is low-risk. adding to release notes: "Temporarily reduced heartbeat fanout in us-east-2 after transient pref fill/backfill amplification; draining two hosts."
neil: command to reduce fanout: `runtimectl set probes.heartbeat.fanout=4 --scope=canary-use2` applied.
ops-bot: drain scheduled: `infra ctl drain host-use2-09 --reason "heartbeat-fanout-spike"`
harry: running 200 quick-heartbeats now. ETA 2m.
(2m later)
neil: 200-run results: 200 -> 1 failure (0.5%), p95 170ms. host-use2-09 reports lower retransmit after NIC qdisc reset.
tara: infra confirms NIC firmware on use2-03 had a queued interrupt storm; they applied mitigations. INF-5342 updated.
harry: decision: maintain hold for 10 more minutes, keep fanout at 4 for canary, and prepare routing-pin procedure for us-east-2 (manual) to fallback variant v7-stable if metrics degrade again. Also push note to changelog: link INF-5342 and steps performed.
neil: adding small changelog blurb: "Reduced heartbeat fanout + drained two hosts in us-east-2 during canary verification due to transient network retransmits. Monitoring resumed."
deploy-bot: Canary policy: rollout paused by auto-hold due to elevated p95 in us-east-2. Resume allowed when p95 < 250ms and errors < 0.5% for a continuous 10m window. Telemetry archive: https://telemetry/internal/archives/3412349999
tara: ack. I'll follow up with infra postmortem link once INF-5342 is closed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
